entry.title: Wide Short — Pack of 6
entry.summaryHtml: Cream, cedar, toasted nuts, coffee, cocoa, earth and pepper come through with more smoke volume and breadth than the standard Cohiba Short. The 31-ring format keeps the classic dry Cuban cedar-and-coffee character while softening some of the narrow cigarillo sharpness, with cocoa, nuttiness and gentle sweetness appearing through the middle.
entry.noteHtml: The Wide Short is Cohiba’s larger machine-made short format, launched after the standard Short with a longer body and thicker diameter. Review consensus is notably positive on draw, burn and smoke output for a cigarillo, with the main limitation being the short session rather than lack of flavour.

note: Add Cohiba Wide Short at rank 19 in Coronets & Cigarillos. Benchmark Cigar Hut’s current A$72 pack of 6, equivalent to A$12 per cigarillo.
